services.name: Banana Boat
services.desc: Looking for a fun and exciting activity to do with your family or friends? Look no further than the banana boat ride at Shoreline Watersports! Our banana boat rides are the perfect way to cool off on a hot day and experience the thrill of being towed behind a jet ski. Our professional and experienced staff is dedicated to ensuring a safe and enjoyable trip out on the water. We welcome participants of all shapes, sizes, and abilities, accommodating everyone based on weather and water conditions. blurb: Guests can soar 400+ feet above the water parasailing and observe sea life and coastline. Banana boat rides last 10-15 minutes and are thrilling for all ages. The company has been operating since 1998 and prioritizes safety and fun.
highlights: See diverse sea life and coastline

quotes.author: Jeff Petrone
quotes.text: Great crew and experience. Fair pricing and easy access. You'll take a banana boat towed by a jet ski out to the boat and back. Great photos and my 7 year old loved it. We saw 3 sand sharks and a turtle from the air. Loved the feet dip towards the end

quotes.author: Kittys Bracelets
quotes.text: We did the banana boat ride! I loved it it was super fun and the driver was super nice also when some one fell off the guy stopped to make sure they were alright! I hope we’ll do it again!

quotes.author: Landon Basketball
quotes.text: Great job. My family and I really enjoyed it. I really recommend going. Great service and very professional. The employees were very kind and helpful. Can’t wait to go again!

quotes.author: Nicole Hart
quotes.text: We had a great time parasailing with the crew! It was our first time to parasail, and they made the whole experience wonderful! Felt safe the entire time and we had a blast!

quotes.author: Gabrielle Landaeta
quotes.text: We went parasailing and it included a banana boat ride to the boat. We had Captain Richard and Ethan. They were great and both gave us a wonderful experience. Thanks again!

quotes.author: Christopher Pinn
quotes.text: Truly a fun experience!!!! My family had a wonderful time. The entire staff was GREAT!!! We'll definitely choose them on our next vacation.

quotes.author: Danielle Darnell
quotes.text: This was the 2nd time my kids have parasailed and they had a great time. Kind and courteous staff. Captain and first mate are top notch.

quotes.author: Angela Babcock
quotes.text: The Captain and his mate were great. Awesome experience for my family.
